technology.title: Modern diode laser technology — matched to your skin
technology.imageAlt: Diode laser device in the treatment room
technology.p1: Our studio works with the modern ALIX TWIN AI Smart 5000 8W — an intelligent system for professional and especially comfortable hair removal. Four coordinated wavelengths — 755, 808, 940 and 1064 nm with Boost — make it possible to treat different skin and hair types.
technology.p2: An AI scanner analyses skin type, hair colour and hair density and helps us adjust the settings individually. The powerful cooling system chills the handpiece to as low as −26 °C, which makes the treatment far more comfortable.
technology.p3: Interchangeable tips allow precise work on small as well as large body zones — for a fast, gentle and individually tuned treatment.

specialist.p1: My name is Elena and I am your specialist for professional laser hair removal. For [number] years I have been helping women and men on their way to smooth skin and a well-cared-for feeling.
specialist.p2: Through my training in [qualifications/specialisations] and regular further education, I work to modern quality and hygiene standards.
specialist.p3: For every treatment I take the time for a personal consultation, analyse your skin and hair type and adjust the device settings individually. What matters to me is that you feel safe, comfortable and well looked after throughout.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We take the protection of your personal data seriously. This notice explains what data we process on this website, why we process it, and the rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

controller.title: Controller
controller.body: The controller responsible for processing personal data on this website is {{businessName}}, {{address}}. E-mail: {{email}}, phone: {{phone}}.

hosting.title: Access data
hosting.body: When you visit this site, technical access data (IP address, date and time, browser type) is processed in server logs to deliver the site securely and detect abuse (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR). Log data is deleted after a short period and is not merged with other data.

contactForm.title: Contact form
contactForm.body: If you use the contact form, we store your name, e-mail address and message in order to answer your enquiry (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR). If e-mail notifications are configured, we additionally send you a confirmation of receipt. Messages are deleted once your enquiry is resolved, at the latest after 12 months.

booking.title: Online booking and payments (Altegio)
booking.body: Appointments are booked through the external service Altegio (alteg.io). The booking calendar is embedded only after you give consent (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR). Once loaded, Altegio processes your IP address and sets cookies, and the data you enter — name, phone number, e-mail, selected service and, for online payments, your payment details — is processed by Altegio on its own pages. Please refer to Altegio's privacy policy for details. Consultation and appointment requests made through our form are additionally stored by us so our staff can follow up; they are deleted once handled, at the latest after 12 months. To alert our team, the details of such a request — your name, phone number and preferred appointment — are also sent to us by e-mail and as a message in Telegram; in the course of that transmission they are processed by Telegram (Telegram FZ-LLC, Dubai, United Arab Emirates) outside the EU (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR — our legitimate interest in responding quickly). You can withdraw your consent at any time via “Cookie settings” in the footer.

storage.title: Cookies and local storage
storage.body: This website sets no tracking cookies of its own. We use your browser's local storage for two strictly functional purposes: your language preference (i18nextLng) and your cookie decision (cookie-consent). Functional storage of this kind requires no consent. Cookies from Altegio are set only after you accept the booking calendar. The map in the contact section is loaded directly from OpenStreetMap when the page opens; your IP address is transmitted to OpenStreetMap in the process.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, rectify and erase your personal data, to receive a copy of it, to restrict or object to its processing, and to withdraw any consent with effect for the future. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority; the authority competent for us is the Bavarian Data Protection Authority (BayLDA).

imprint.title: Imprint
imprint.dispute: The European Commission provides a platform for online dispute resolution: https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr. We are neither obliged nor willing to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply to all treatments and appointments at elcorix. Please have them reviewed legally and adapted to your actual processes before going live.

scope.title: Scope
scope.body: These terms apply to all treatments arranged through this website or by phone. Any deviating agreement must be made in text form.

appointments.title: Booking an appointment
appointments.body: Appointments can be arranged through the online calendar, by phone, via WhatsApp or through the consultation form. The contract comes into effect when we confirm the appointment.

cancellation.title: Cancellations and rescheduling
cancellation.body: Please cancel or reschedule an appointment at least 24 hours in advance. For later cancellations or no-shows we may charge a cancellation fee.

payment.title: Prices and payment
payment.body: The prices shown at the time of booking apply and include VAT. Package prices cover the stated number of sessions. Payment is made in the studio or, where offered, online through Altegio.

liability.title: Your part and our liability
liability.body: A safe treatment depends on accurate information about your skin type, medication and pre-existing conditions, and on following the before- and aftercare instructions. We cannot accept liability for harm caused by incomplete information or by disregarding those instructions.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.intro: elcorix stands for permanent hair removal that feels safe, honest and comfortable. Three things matter most to us.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.body: Every treatment starts with an analysis of your skin and hair type and a patch test. We work to documented protocols, with single-use materials and tested equipment — and we say so openly when a treatment is not suitable.

honesty.title: Honest advice
honesty.body: We do not promise results we cannot deliver. You will know in advance how many sessions are realistically needed, what that costs and what the alternatives are — with no sales pressure.

care.title: Time for you
care.body: We schedule enough time per appointment so you can settle in, ask questions and feel well looked after from start to finish.
